class.name: SteamPurchaseOutcome
class.brief_description: Backend-confirmed snapshot of one Steam order.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates the typed receipt from verified backend state. Provide a canonical nonzero 64-bit decimal order ID, a valid currency code, and a positive total in Steam's units. Invalid data returns null.

members.member: The canonical decimal order ID assigned by the backend.
Three-letter uppercase currency code for the order total.
Total in Steam's units for the order currency.
The latest order state confirmed by the game backend.

constants.constant: Steam is waiting for the player to authorize the order.
The backend is confirming an uncertain outcome.
The backend confirms the durable grant.
The backend confirms the grant was reversed.
The backend confirms that only some purchased grants were reversed.
